name: Clockspinning
oracle_text:
Buyback {3} (You may pay an additional {3} as you cast this spell. If you do, put this card into your hand as it resolves.)
Choose a counter on target permanent or suspended card. Remove that counter from that permanent or card or put another of those counters on it.
blocked_sentences: Choose a counter on target permanent or suspended card. Remove that counter from that permanent or card or put another of those counters on it.

needs.what: remove_counters reading `counter: {"binding": <as>}` -- the kind a choose_counter_kind bound -- so "remove that counter" takes one of the chosen kind off the target
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_counter_kind binds the kind and add_counters puts one of it, but the loader allows the bound-kind mapping only on add_counters (and counters_on); remove_counters takes a printed kind or any_kind, which asks the kind again rather than using the one chosen

needs.what: one target spec whose pool spans a permanent on the battlefield and a suspended card in exile -- 'target permanent or suspended card' -- the `spell_or_permanent` shape with a battlefield half and an exile half read by the `suspended` selector key, offered and re-checked (608.2b) per the zone the object is in
needs.why_existing_wont_do: a target spec has one kind and one zone: `card_in_exile` with `suspended: true` reaches only the suspended half, `permanent` only the battlefield, and `any_of` narrows one zone's pool so it cannot join the two; two specs would be a card that targets twice

needs.what: suspend's 'when the last time counter is removed from it, if it's exiled, you may cast it without paying its mana cost' (702.62a) must fire whenever the last time counter comes off by any road, not only during the upkeep tick or time travel
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `suspend.tick` and `time_travel` call `cast_suspended` themselves after their own removals; a `remove_counters` op that takes the last time counter off a suspended card strands it in exile with zero counters, never cast
